macros.name: Obliteration Trigger Macro — Raise Dead
macros.content:
#showtooltip Pillar of Frost
/use trinket
/cast Pillar of Frost
/cast Breath of Sindragosa
/cast Reaper's Mark
/cast Raise Dead
macros.purpose: Maximising the value of Obliteration means fully utilising all the available GCDs you have during the window. Since Pillar of Frost is off the GCD, we want to macro it with a GCD-button to start using your abilities ASAP in the window. When playing Deathbringer , you can use Pillar of Frost with Reaper's Mark to simplify you rotation. In AoE, it is recommend to use Reaper's Mark before pillar. Furthermore, you can add in Breath of Sindragosa in this macro to further cut down on the button requirement. For Rider of the Apocalypse , we end up in a more complicated situation as the on-GCD ability we use with our Pillar of Frost changes depending on situation. We have separate macros for Frost Strike , Glacial Advance , Obliterate , Frostscythe and Howling Blast . Choosing what macro you press is exactly like following your standard priority (Frost Strike with Frostbane, Obliterate with Killing Machine in Single Target etc). If you want to fully optimise each one of your standard abilities has a pillar macro version as well with the following structure: The exact macros to use are the written out below. Important to note, you also use the Frostscythe macro and Obliterate macro with Deathbringer when you do the early Reaper's Mark tech.
